brief.title: Run single-pass Aho-Corasick literal scans and ECMA-262 portable grep rule checks
brief.plain_summary: Compile AhoCorasickAutomaton failure and output links for single-pass literal scanning, validate ECMA-262 regex portability, scrub local home paths, refuse unnegated outbound effect verbs without flagging negated sentences and block placeholder UI stamps.
brief.outcome: Deterministic literal, regex portability, path-scrub and copy-hygiene report.

brief.title: Independently verify strict JSON canonicalization, clause-balanced captions and AST magic-literal conformance
